texts.preamble: Chetan Malik And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 31 July, 2019 Bench: Pradeep Kumar Singh Baghel, Piyush Agrawal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 21 Case :- Writ - C No. - 7416 of 2018 Petitioner :- Chetan Malik And Another Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
texts.facts: It is stated that the said restaurant is registered under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and a copy of the certificate is on the record. The petitioner is aggrieved by a notice issued by the Sub Inspector, Police Station Expressway, Gautam Budh Nagar, U.P., whereby the petitioners have been asked to stop Hukka Bar.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the respondents have no authority under the law to restrain the petitioners to run Hukka lounge. Learned counsel for the petitioners has placed reliance on a judgment of the Supreme Court in Civil Appeal No. 10836 of 2014 (Narinder S. Chadha and others v. Municipal Corporation of Greater Chetan Malik And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 31 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197536745/ 1 Mumbai and others). Our attention has been drawn to an order passed by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Writ-C No. 7410 of 2018 (Ramesh Verma and another v. State of U.P. and others) dated 10th April, 2018, wherein similar notice issued by the Sub-Inspector, Police Station Expressway, G.B. Nagar was challenged. Under the notice impugned, the Sub-Inspector, Thana Expressway has instructed the petitioners not to continue with "Hukka Bar" which as per him is an illegal activity and further that in the event of failure to close the activities, he shall be left with no option but to seize and seal the Hukka Bar. The submission of learned counsel for the petitioners is that running of Hukka Bar is a valid activity as "The Cigarette and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003" no where restrict such activity or treat that as an offence. To substantiate the contention, reliance is placed upon a decision of Supreme Court in Civil Appeal No.10836 of 2014, Narinder S. Chadha and others Vs. Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai and others decided on 8th December, 2014.
